lena: FYI I opened three linked PRs to reorganize examples and update anchors. Need merge order and one merger to avoid flicker.

omar: List?

lena: PR #7610 move examples -> examples/python|js, PR #7611 update migration guide anchors, PR #7612 add _redirects for old example paths.

tia: Redirects-first or moves-first?

lena: Moves-first minimizes redirects to dead targets; plan: 7610 -> 7611 -> 7612 in a tight window.

omar: I'll merge but want previews green. Add linkinator step to PR template.

docs-ci-bot: docs-preview: build started for PR #7610 (https://deploy-preview-7610--docs.redwood.dev)

tia: Note: anchor id for "Client auth" becomes client-token-auth after rename; update internal links in 7611.

omar: Good catch. Also add a smoke script I'll run after each merge to curl critical anchors.

lena: I've rebased 7611; preview is up. If previews pass, Omar can merge at 09:30 PT tomorrow.

omar: Approved 7610/7611. Will merge 7610 then 7611 then 7612 and run smoke checks between. Ping here when merged. :thumbsup:
